items.question: Who surpasses the addressed lord in worthiness to bestow compassion?
premises: The lord is directly addressed as the standard of comparison.
Bestowing compassion is the act under consideration.
The question implies no one exceeds the lord in this worthiness.
items.inference: The addressed lord is uniquely supreme in the capacity to show compassion.
items.plain_english: O Lord, who is more worthy than you to show compassion?
